title: Cuboid To 3D Simulation
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Cuboid_To_3D_Simulation.md
text: Convert actor from cuboid coordinates to 3D simulation coordinates, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Specify Actor ID} enables ID specification of cuboid actor, {ActorID used for conversion} sets the actorID value of cuboid actor and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Cuboid actor pose in world coordinates Simulink ® bus containing MATLAB ® structure

ports.summary: Lateral position of actor in 3D simulation coordinates numeric scalar

ports.summary: Yaw orientation angle of actor in 3D simulation coordinates numeric scalar

params.name: Specify Actor ID
params.values: Enable ID specification of cuboid actor off (default) | on

params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
